label: GOAL005B_OFFLINE_ENDING_AUDIT

findings: session.ended is handled before the ended-state early return, so an ACK remains receivable during the bounded closing window.
Ordinary reply, transcript, audio and tool events are ignored after End; stop cancels pending work and stops local input/playback immediately.
Repeated end/stop calls share one promise and send at most one session.end; no retry or new connection is created.
The existing ten-second maximum includes cleanup and is clamped to socket creation plus the validated 600/900-second absolute cap.
voice.ts delegates tool-name validation to VoiceProtocol and needs no local inspect_gate allowlist change.
The documented explicit ending sequence is session.end, then session.ended, then socket closure. Closing the socket alone may leave a billable resume window.
The reviewed pages give no numeric acknowledgement latency guarantee.
Client tool results remain correlated to a valid latest completed reply; interrupted pending tools must be discarded. An extra tool result or reply is not an ending acknowledgement.

clockAndEvidenceBoundaries: Differences use browser performance.now timestamps from the same attempt. Driver elapsedMs and observedAt receipt timestamps are not substituted for browser event times.
The browser end.requested marker is emitted by the send interceptor immediately before session.end; it does not prove the earliest UI intent or button-click time.
Attempt12 socket.close is retained in lifecycle.jsonl after the earlier audio-evidence snapshot. Both sources remain unchanged.
A socket close event can occur after the local close invocation due to WebSocket closing/event-loop scheduling; these retained events do not identify the exact close invocation time.
Observed ordinary replies after End do not establish ACK delivery, handler failure, provider billing duration, or a completed recovery within the expired deadline.
Attempts11/13 retain missing-ACK uncertainty and null provider duration. Local duration and clean close are not remote-end confirmation.

attempts.failure: QA fork southeast passage recovery exceeded 120 seconds.

expanded.coverageLimitation: Initial observation: the late reply.audio fixture used audio instead of the supported data field. This run did not establish suppression of a valid PCM event. Its original log and source hashes are retained; the corrected positive-control run is recorded below.

newTests: Goal005B ending audit: late ordinary reply cannot restart work; missing ACK remains unknown
Goal005B ending audit: late ordinary reply cannot restart work; constructed late ACK remains receivable
offlineValidation.schedules: Rounded attempt13 reply offsets are replayed after End. Late audio, a physical proposal tool, repeated session.ready and optional 9.2-second ACK are constructed adversarial inputs, not invented historical events.
coverage: late ordinary reply/tool events; valid-audio coverage corrected below
manual/automatic cap exhaustion at both 600 and 900 seconds
clean close without ACK remains unknown
offlineValidation.interpretation: A passing baseline with additional passing adverse schedules; no failing-first production repair is claimed. Offline transport tests do not establish why the real provider omitted ACK.

audioFixtureCorrection.finding: Review found a test-fixture field error, not a production ending defect. The initial late-audio assertion did not use the supported data field and therefore provided limited coverage.
audioFixtureCorrection.change: Both adverse schedules now send the same valid data event containing two PCM16 samples before and after End. A positive control proves exactly one playback-adapter invocation before End; the count remains one after End.

diffCheck.evidence: Tool output; no separate corrected log.

audioFixtureCorrection.interpretation: Test-only coverage strengthening with a positive control, not a failing production repair or new provider evidence. Initial logs/hashes and historical outcomes remain unchanged. This proves adapter event handling, not physical speaker playback or human listening.

disposition: Retain the existing finite ending policy and historical missing-ACK outcomes. No deadline enlargement, fabricated ACK, real call, accounting mutation or production ending edit is justified by this audit.
